sources.title: Apple CarPlay
sources.note: Supported parked video now exists; category/entitlement and vehicle support still apply. No factory-camera API established.

sources.title: Android for Cars
sources.note: Android Auto projection differs from embedded AAOS; distribution categories and driving/parked restrictions apply. Do not infer camera access.

sources.title: Mazda 2019 Mazda3 manual
sources.note: Describes vehicle cameras/360 view. Exact Sport trim, market and factory video SDK not established. Large US manual retrieval also failed; do not infer connector pinout.

sources.title: SAE diagnostics scope
sources.note: Emission-related diagnostic requests/responses are not generic camera transport. Current J1979-2 is a separate revision; this old abstract is not current compliance guidance.

sources.title: Android USB host/accessory
sources.note: USB roles and power differ. Host/OTG support does not guarantee a UVC camera is exposed by Camera2.

sources.title: NVIDIA GMSL camera framework
sources.note: Serializer/deserializer, sensor driver and device-tree integration required. A cable adapter cannot unlock proprietary OEM video.

sources.title: Raspberry Pi camera software
sources.note: Use the modern camera stack; validate sensor/OS/driver tuple. Old raspicam recipes are not the selected path.

sources.title: V4L2 timestamp flags
sources.note: Timestamp flags identify monotonic timing. Driver timestamp origin and exposure timing still need verification on current kernels.

sources.title: TI automotive power protection
sources.note: Automotive supplies need transient, reverse-polarity, overload and load-dump protection. Reference design is not certification of an AETHRON installation.

sources.title: PX4 ROS 2 guide
sources.note: Guide includes Ubuntu 22.04/Humble and Agent v2.4.3. Firmware and px4_msgs definitions must match; simulator clock bridge needs matching Gazebo integration.

sources.title: PX4 uXRCE-DDS
sources.note: PX4 client v2.x is incompatible with Agent v3.x. Topics/board support depend on firmware configuration.

sources.title: ArduPilot companion computers
sources.note: Companion communicates MAVLink telemetry with autopilot. Cameras/pixels and command authority require separate integration.

sources.title: MAVLink camera protocol
sources.note: Stream descriptors identify URI/type/status; MAVLink does not guarantee frame-synchronized video metadata. Pixel transport must be negotiated separately.

sources.title: MAVSDK releases
sources.note: Upstream release metadata observed, not an AETHRON compatibility test. Pin release/commit and generated language bindings together.

sources.title: DJI Mobile SDK products
sources.note: Product list includes Mini 3/3 Pro/4 Pro, Mavic 3 Enterprise and several Matrice models. Support is per SDK/controller/firmware; not all DJI drones.

sources.title: DJI Android V5 release
sources.note: Exact upstream release observed. No equivalent iOS V5 support inferred; detailed features and vendor terms must be checked per tuple.

sources.title: DJI Payload SDK
sources.note: Public URL retrieved without readable content. Payload connector/electrical/activation/firmware matrix and redistribution terms remain unresolved; no compatibility commitment.

sources.title: Parrot Olympe
sources.note: Linux SDK documents ANAFI family video-frame access and Sphinx simulation; prebuilt pip path is x86_64 desktop only. ARM requires separate source-build verification.

sources.title: Visage thermal UAV PoC
sources.note: Thermal small-object work discusses FLIT, Kalman/Hungarian, solar loading and SUAVE-600 v3. Qualitative vendor PoC is a hypothesis source, not independently reproducible AETHRON accuracy/range evidence.

sources.title: FLIR expanded thermal data
sources.note: Thermal training candidate. Free access does not establish redistribution/model-commercialization rights; obtain current dataset agreement before download or bundling.

sources.title: KAIST multispectral dataset
sources.note: Primary site inaccessible through research tool. Keep evaluation candidate only; no assumed permissive license or redistribution.

sources.title: FLIR thermal limitations
sources.note: Conventional glass and opaque barriers obstruct LWIR; fog/rain can limit range. Thermal imaging is not precise through-wall perception.

sources.title: SWIR imaging physics
sources.note: SWIR predominantly uses reflected radiation for ordinary scenes; do not treat it as passive LWIR or assume operation without appropriate illumination.

sources.title: TI mmWave sensing
sources.note: mmWave offers nonvisible sensing. Vendor robustness statements are not our weather, resolution or class-accuracy qualification.

sources.title: ONNX Runtime execution providers
sources.note: Providers supply hardware-specific execution. Measure supported nodes, fallback, cold start, numerical equivalence and actual host performance.

sources.title: YOLOX source
sources.version: upstream main; existing model separately frozen
sources.note: Apache-2.0 source candidate; preserve repository model digest. Detector family/license is not a trained thermal/UAV capability.

sources.title: ByteTrack source
sources.note: Detection association baseline candidate, including lower-score observations. Preserve geometry-only path and frozen v3 continuation/expiry rules; do not import unrelated re-identification modules.

sources.title: TrackEval
sources.note: Reference HOTA evaluator candidate. Pin code before new evaluation; current frozen v3 frame-level metrics remain authoritative.

sources.title: OpenAPI
sources.note: Use JSON Schema-compatible typed HTTP contracts; transport schema cannot enforce trusted clocks or all temporal semantics.

sources.title: FastAPI features
sources.note: Typed validation, OpenAPI and ASGI ecosystem justify optional server boundary. Strict raw-byte duplicate/depth validation must precede framework parsing.

sources.title: PyPA TestPyPI
sources.note: Test index is distinct from production PyPI. Avoid dependency confusion via extra-index fallback; local wheel consumer is first gate.

sources.title: ROS Image
sources.note: Image carries encoding, dimensions, stride, header/frame information. Pair with CameraInfo and validate timestamps/size.

sources.title: ROS CameraInfo
sources.note: Calibration metadata and optical-frame conventions support adapter transforms; presence alone does not prove calibration validity.

sources.title: ISO functional safety
sources.note: Conditional road-vehicle E/E functional-safety lifecycle. Public overview is not a clause-level compliance assessment or certificate.

sources.title: ISO SOTIF
sources.note: Functional insufficiency and foreseeable misuse require intended-domain validation beyond software correctness.

sources.title: ISO/SAE cybersecurity
sources.note: Road-vehicle cybersecurity risk engineering; applicability determined by integrator/system scope.

sources.title: UNECE vehicle regulations
sources.note: Cybersecurity/software-update management regulations concern applicable type approvals; not an automatic requirement/certificate for every local library installation.

sources.title: EASA open category
sources.note: Category/aircraft/operation requirements govern EU trials. Review current national zones and operational authorization; perception is not flight permission.

sources.title: Swedish UAS operations
sources.note: Sweden-specific operations/airspace and imagery dissemination requirements need checking before trials/publication.

sources.title: FAA Part 107 operations
sources.note: US commercial remote-pilot, night and airspace conditions apply where relevant; do not use EU assumptions in US deployment.

sources.title: FAA Remote ID
sources.note: Registration/Remote ID requirements and exceptions must be assessed for the aircraft and operation. Do not disable required broadcasts.

sources.title: EDPB video privacy
sources.note: Lawful basis, necessity, transparency and retention apply even without biometric identity. Consent is not automatically the only or sufficient lawful basis.

sources.title: Tesla Fleet API
sources.note: Primary URL yielded no readable API detail in tool. OEM-authorized API pathway remains possible, but no raw factory-camera endpoint or permission is established here.

sources.title: FastAPI package metadata
sources.note: Version candidate observed on research date; not installed, security-audited or qualified by Phase 0.

sources.title: Uvicorn package metadata
sources.note: Candidate ASGI server version; dependency closure/platform wheel compatibility must be locked and tested in Phase 1.

sources.title: Pydantic package metadata
sources.note: Candidate strict envelope models; not a replacement for frozen byte parser.

sources.title: HTTPX package metadata
sources.note: Candidate external consumer/test client, not a core dependency.

sources.title: Visage Edge AI
sources.note: Linked from PoC; web tool fetch failed. No performance or deployment claim derived from unavailable contents.

sources.title: Visage AI safety
sources.note: Linked from PoC; web tool fetch failed. No certification or assurance inferred.

sources.title: Visage autonomy
sources.note: Linked from PoC; web tool fetch failed. AETHRON safety floor overrides vendor capability breadth.

sources.title: Dist-Tracker / FLIT paper
sources.note: Publisher excerpt describes L2/IoU association for small objects. Full PDF retrieval returned 403; do not assume uninspected implementation details or transfer results.

sources.title: Anti-UAV challenge data
sources.note: Primary challenge describes thermal crossover, dynamic backgrounds, scale and multiple-UAV sequences. Data access terms must be distinguished from repository code license.

sources.title: Anti-UAV repository license
sources.note: MIT code license observed; verify terms of each separately hosted data archive before redistributing images or trained artifacts.

sources.title: Electrical loads
sources.note: Road-vehicle electrical-load scope explicitly excludes motorcycle/moped environmental testing and does not cover EMC; do not apply indiscriminately.

sources.title: Laser safety
sources.note: Laser product classification/requirements potentially apply to LiDAR/active sensors. Final assembled product needs assessment; module label alone is insufficient.

sources.title: Lamp/LED photobiological safety
sources.note: Optical lamp/LED safety scope differs from lasers. Assessment needed for active NIR installation and exposure geometry.

sources.title: OpenCV Kalman primitive
sources.note: Standard Kalman primitive illustrates library alternative; does not establish current 4.13 numerical/ABI equivalence to frozen core.

sources.title: MAVSDK license
sources.note: BSD three-clause text retrieved and hashed locally; capture exact release license when redistributing dependencies.

sources.title: Public AETHRON main
sources.note: Direct anonymous HTTP retrieval confirmed baseline main SHA; no repository mutation.

sources.title: Public AETHRON Camera
sources.note: Direct HTTP 200 AETHRON HTML response; no browser/device-camera, service-worker, offline-cache or inference execution claimed.

sources.title: Apple background capture interruption
sources.note: Apple documents camera interruption in background. No generic unattended auto-boot camera app entitlement is inferred; supported special platform contexts require exact API/entitlement review.

sources.title: Android foreground camera services
sources.note: Camera while-in-use permission constrains background and BOOT_COMPLETED launches, with documented exceptions. Do not claim arbitrary camera auto-start on consumer phones.

sources.title: systemd service reference
sources.note: Service restart/watchdog semantics inform planned boot package. Actual distro build must be pinned and tested; process watchdog does not substitute for scene freshness.

sources.title: systemd execution isolation
sources.note: Service privilege/filesystem/device isolation is profile-specific; required camera/device access must remain explicit. No unit installed in Phase 0.
